version.description:
Sanad is your daily companion for wellbeing and self-growth. Simple tools help you understand your feelings, ease the pressure of your day and build better habits, with coaching and support sessions with specialists from wherever you are.

Coaching and support sessions
Book a one-to-one session with a specialist by voice call or chat to set your goals, manage life's pressures and grow.

Smart assistant, around the clock
An assistant that helps you work through your feelings and offers practical exercises right away.

Daily mood tracking
Log your mood every day and spot patterns in clear charts.

Meditation and relaxation
Breathing, meditation and relaxation exercises that help you lower stress.

A safe, supportive community
Share your experience with people who understand, with clear rules and the option to report and block.

Self-check quizzes and learning paths
Short stress and mood quizzes with instant results, plus structured learning paths with lessons and exercises.

My private journal
An encrypted journal that stays on your device only.

Privacy first: your data is encrypted and your conversations are confidential.

Sanad is a wellbeing and self-growth app. It does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment and does not replace a doctor. If you are in danger, call your local emergency number now.

Terms: https://sanadtherapy.com/terms
Privacy: https://sanadtherapy.com/privacy
version.promotionalText: Grow and feel better every day: mood tracking, relaxation exercises, a smart assistant and coaching sessions with specialists from wherever you are.
